DATA STRUCTURES - Examination 2024
Total Marks: 70
SECTION A
1.
Attempt all questions in brief.
(a) Define array and linked list.
(b) What is a circular queue?
(c) State the time complexity of merge sort.
(d) What is a stack? Give two applications.
(e) What is a binary search tree?
(f) Differentiate between BFS and DFS.
(g) What is a hash function?
SECTION B
2.
Attempt any three of the following:
(a) Differentiate between array and linked list with suitable examples.
(b) Explain stack data structure with push and pop algorithms.
(c) Explain inorder, preorder and postorder traversal of a tree.
(d) Explain hashing and different collision handling methods.
(e) Explain merge sort and analyze its time complexity.
SECTION C
3.
Attempt any one part of the following:
(a) Explain binary search tree with insertion and deletion examples.
(b) Explain BFS and DFS traversal of a graph with an example.
4.
Attempt any one part of the following:
(a) Write the binary search algorithm and discuss its complexity.
(b) Write a short note on AVL trees and rotations.

DATA STRUCTURES - Examination 2023

SECTION A

3.
